svg.text: Three tables in third normal form (3NF). Each patient and each doctor can have many appointments.
A booking: one patient, one doctor, one time slot
Doctors, their fee and consulting room
A patient can have zero or many appointments.
Every appointment has exactly one patient.
A doctor can have zero or many appointments.
Every appointment has exactly one doctor.
A doctor can never have two appointments at the same
active_flag is 1 while an appointment is BOOKED and becomes
NULL when it is CANCELLED. A UNIQUE index ignores NULLs, so a
cancelled appointment stays in the table for refund history
but no longer blocks the slot: someone else can book it.
U2 does the same for patients: one appointment per patient
Slots start on the hour or half hour
Only within working hours (last slot 16:30, ends 17:00)
Refund is 0%, 50% or 100% and never more than was paid
A cancelled booking must record when and how much was refunded
A patient or doctor with appointments cannot be deleted
Each patient email is used only once
Checked in the app, not the database: bookings must be in the future, and a doctor has at most
12 appointments per day (counted while the doctor row is locked).
